info.title: Limen read-only management API
info.description: The seven existing read-only management endpoints. Requires a separate manager key; disabled management returns 404. All operations use GET with no body. Unknown or repeated query parameters are rejected; raw query maximum 4096 bytes, response maximum 1 MiB. Defaults: concurrency 4, deadline 2000 ms. Success payloads use data; list cursors are present and nullable. UTC timestamps use RFC3339 milliseconds. Persisted token/byte counts and lifecycle counters are decimal strings; resource-limit values are JSON integers as currently serialized. No CORS permission headers are sent.

managerKey.description: Independent auth.manager_key; never a client api_key. Exactly one Authorization: Bearer header. Query and Cookie credentials are not accepted.

From.name: from
From.description: Inclusive request start time. Supply together with to; when both are absent, defaults to the last 24 hours. Maximum window is 31 days. Cursor pages inherit the original window.

To.name: to
To.description: Exclusive request start time; must be later than from. Supply both endpoints or neither.

Model.name: model
Model.description: Exact match; 1-128 UTF-8 bytes. Repeated cursor-page filters must match the original filter.

Provider.name: provider
Provider.description: Exact match; 1-128 UTF-8 bytes. Repeated cursor-page filters must match the original filter.

Cursor.name: cursor
Cursor.description: Opaque run-bound cursor. Later pages may supply only cursor and limit; explicitly repeated filters must match. Service restart expires the cursor.

ListLimit.name: limit
ListLimit.description: Maximum rows; the response byte budget can shorten a page.

LogLimit.name: limit
LogLimit.description: Maximum matching log entries in this scan window.

GroupBy.name: groupBy
GroupBy.description: One aggregation dimension; day uses UTC calendar dates.

Section.name: section
Section.description: Defaults to server without a cursor; a cursor inherits its models/providers section. limit/cursor are invalid for server.

FileId.name: fileId
FileId.description: Exact log file identity; defaults to the active file. No path is accepted.

MinLevel.name: minLevel
MinLevel.description: Includes this severity and all more severe levels; omitted means no level filter.

ClientStream.name: clientStream
ClientStream.description: Exact original client stream intent. Only true or false.

UpstreamMedia.name: upstreamMedia
UpstreamMedia.description: Exact upstream media classification (json/sse/other). Missing response media does not match any selected value.

PerformanceOutcome.name: performanceOutcome
PerformanceOutcome.description: Filters only performance and phase samples. Token consumption, request states and outcomes retain all matching requests.

LogsPage.description: Reverse window in one file. Empty data with a non-null nextCursor means the scan window had no matching entries. scannedBytes is at most 1048576.

ResourceLimits.description: Loaded resource limits. These fields are JSON integers, including byte limits, because the server serializes ResourceLimits directly.

origin.description: URL origin only; no path, query or credentials.

ConfigResponse.description: section=server returns a server object without nextCursor. section=models/providers returns the corresponding homogeneous array and nextCursor. Empty model/provider pages overlap, so this union uses anyOf.

RequestMetrics.description: TTFT excludes role-only, usage and control events. Downstream time means body delivery by this gateway, not client network receipt. Buffered delivery is excluded from native downstream TTFT aggregates. TPS values are server-derived; null is not zero.

RequestTimings.description: Monotonic microseconds. Milestones and elapsed spans have separate meanings and cannot all be summed.

MetricSummary.description: Server-computed exact bounded sample statistics. Empty samples have null statistics. Do not average group percentiles.

GenerationParameters.description: Fixed allowlist projection, bounded to 4 KiB per snapshot. Excludes messages, tools, headers, credentials, stop strings and arbitrary extensions. An omitted field means not recorded, never a default value.
